aggregate_reason: per-component denominators differ and no two scopes share a contract, so no total is formed
contract_rules: same DUT: identical declared structural-build source files (dut.source_files_sha256) for the same component
same point set: identical saved point map (dut.point_set_sha256) and canonical denominator (dut.denominator_sha256)
same workload: identical recorded command sequence, execution nonce normalised (workload.commands_sha256), same command count and local ticks
same budget: identical replay_budget and executed command count; a search budget is not represented by an offline replay and stays unknown
same explicit coverage mode: offline recorded-prefix replay on both sides (online and fixed-time coverage are false)
both sides instrumented: a prefix without its own instrumented replay has no covered/total and is never compared

missing_inputs: a second tool's offline line/block measurement of the same DUT source files and point set
that tool's replay of the identical recorded command sequence (workload.commands_sha256)
evidence of the identical replay budget and executed command count
an explicit coverage-mode declaration (only offline replay exists in this harness; online is false)
an instrumented measurement of the runs' fresh prefixes (they reproduce the commands but carry no coverage)
external_comparison.missing_search_budget: no scope records a fuzzing/search budget: the replay budget is fixed by the measurement, the search budget stays unknown
requirements: same DUT: identical declared structural-build source files (dut.source_files_sha256) for the same component

same workload: identical recorded command sequence, execution nonce normalised (workload.commands_sha256), same command count and local ticks
same budget: identical replay_budget and executed command count; a search budget is not represented by an offline replay and stays unknown
same explicit coverage mode: offline recorded-prefix replay on both sides (online and fixed-time coverage are false)
both sides instrumented: a prefix without its own instrumented replay has no covered/total and is never compared

limitations: Every measured number is offline Verilator line/block coverage of a saved recorded prefix; it is not online, fixed-time or AUC coverage.
A contract match establishes identical DUT sources, point set, workload and replay budget in the same mode; it does not establish equal search budgets or tool superiority.
The fresh prefix of every run reproduces the commands but was not instrumented, so it contributes no covered/total and is never compared.
Per-component denominators differ and are not additive; this package publishes no aggregate coverage.
Input SHA256s make the package reproducible, not the original processes authenticated.
